description: This header file declares the PyRRef class, a Python wrapper for Remote References (RRef) used in PyTorch's distributed RPC framework. It includes method declarations for managing remote references, serialization, profiling, and remote proxy creation.

classes.name: PyRRef
classes.description: A Python-exposed wrapper class for RRef objects in PyTorch's distributed RPC system, supporting operations like serialization, ownership querying, and proxy creation.

methods.name: PyRRef
methods.description: Constructs a PyRRef instance from a Python object and a type hint.

methods.name: PyRRef
methods.description: Constructs a PyRRef from an existing RRef pointer.

methods.name: isOwner
methods.description: Checks if this RRef is owned by the current node.

methods.name: confirmedByOwner
methods.description: Checks if this RRef has been confirmed by the owner.

methods.name: owner
methods.description: Returns information about the owner of this RRef.

methods.name: ownerName
methods.description: Returns the owner's name as a string.

methods.name: toHere
methods.description: Retrieves the referenced object from the remote node, with an optional timeout.

methods.name: localValue
methods.description: Returns the local value of the RRef.

methods.name: str
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the RRef.

methods.name: pickle
methods.description: Serializes the RRef into a Python tuple for pickling.

methods.name: unpickle
methods.description: Deserializes a pickled RRef tuple back into a PyRRef instance.

methods.name: toIValue
methods.description: Converts the RRef to an IValue for serialization.

methods.name: getFuture
methods.description: Returns the future associated with the creation of this RRef.

methods.name: getProfilingFuture
methods.description: Returns the profiling future related to owner creation acknowledgment.

methods.name: setProfilingFuture
methods.description: Sets a profiling future for owner creation acknowledgment.

methods.name: createRRefProxy
methods.description: Creates a proxy object to perform RPC calls on the owner of this RRef.

methods.name: getRRefType
methods.description: Returns the type of the referenced object, with optional timeout and blocking behavior.

methods.name: backward
methods.description: Runs the backward pass with this RRef as the root.

methods.name: backward
methods.description: Runs the backward pass on a given RRef with specified autograd context and graph retention.

methods.name: backwardOwnerRRef
methods.description: Runs backward on an owner RRef with a specified value.
